items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: He had this boy, Chita Howell. He come up, Chris taught him he used to be a drummer. My brother broke him off the drum. Put him on a trumpet and made him famous

ctx.x: Oh, very good. Mm-hmm. That's right. Do you remember who else was in Chris' band? orchestra or his dance orchestra how big it was? Well, he had this boy in there called

Jim Robinson. He played with him in the band. He had this boy, Chita Howell. He come up, Chris taught him he used to be a drummer. My brother broke him off the drum. Put him on a trumpet and made him famous during this time. Who was the clarinet player with the band? Do you remember who played clarinet? Well, they had one fellow that had to try to play clarinet, but he never did make

famous so he just put it down. Do you remember his name? Yeah. Called him Norwood. What was the name again? No, Norwood. Norwood. Yeah. Oh, no. Norwood. But he put it down. He didn't stay with it? No. Do you remember who he had then later?
